snippet.title: FPS Quest 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3989240/FPS_Quest/

An FPS where FPS is your health. If you play poorly, performance drops. Tweak settings on the fly, lower graphics, break the rules, and create glitches to survive.
